9:41.text: Go forth, whether light or heavy,
and strive with your wealth and your lives in the cause of Allāh. That is better for you, if you only knew.

9:44.text: Those who believe in Allāh and the Last Day would not ask permission of you to be excused from striving
with their wealth and their lives. And Allāh is Knowing of those who fear Him.

9:45.text: Only those would ask permission of you who do not believe in Allāh and the Last Day and whose hearts have doubted, and they, in their doubt, are hesitating.

9:46.text: And if they had intended to go forth, they would have prepared for it
preparation. But Allāh disliked their being sent, so He kept them back, and they were told, "Remain

9:47.text: Had they gone forth with you, they would not have increased you except in confusion, and they would have been active among you, seeking
. And among you are avid listeners to them. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
